name: Street Level
description: Street-level vigilantes with limited superpowers. Specialty Power is available at this tier. Iconic minimum is not applicable.

name: Low Level
description: Low-powered heroes. Specialty Power is available at this tier.

name: Standard
description: The default tier for most superhero campaigns.

name: High Level
description: Highly powerful heroes operating at a large scale.

name: Iconic
description: Cosmic or godlike heroes. The 200 HP listed is a bare minimum for this tier.
notes: The rulebook says '200+' Hero Points — the exact budget for Iconic heroes above 200 HP is at GM discretion. Flag for review.
